summary: [standards] (1) The module doc of old_codes says the 0.35 registry is tests/fixtures/codes-0.35.txt; the file is codes-0.35.tsv with exit and retryable. (2) The scenario diff table's list of 117 is exact (rebuilt from git between 31df40acd and 7ccaf0647: the same 117 ids, 86 name-only and 31 meaning under my own normalisation), but two name-only rows correct a 0.35 sentence that named a code the 0.35 binary did not emit, so the old to new pair is no row of the replacement table: dispatch.manifest.12 (0.35 said exit 1 with ADAPTER_REFUSED; the 0.35 binary answered ADAPTER_RESPONSE_INVALID) and gate.check.107 (0.35 said HOOKS_INSTALL_FAILED for a non-directory --repo; the 0.35 binary answers HOOKS_INSTALL_REFUSED, now HOOKS_REPO_INVALID). Both 0.36 sentences are right (real-binary probes: ADAPTER_VALIDATION_FAILED exit 1, HOOKS_REPO_INVALID exit 2). Mark them meaning or say so in the row. (3) atip.codestable.11 checks the count, ids and kind words, not that the rows are the changed scenarios; a table that drops a changed scenario and adds an unchanged one passes.
